name: Confluence Scoring v1
description: MOGO's repository-confirmed implementation: the original numeric confluence-scoring engine, live automatic paper trading, and a historical/TRUE MTF replay engine (simulateTrueMTFReplay). Decision Event observability for JVM remains scan-boundary-only (SCAN_STARTED/SCAN_COMPLETED/ENGINE_ERROR) -- candidate-level observability is structurally deferred because JVM's protected functions call each other directly in the auto-trade path (checkAutoTrades -> evaluateLiveTrigger -> openPaperPosition), unlike ALEX G's equivalent chain. External, source-backed research describing JVM's own trading methodology has not been ingested into this framework -- these rules are fully specified by MOGO's own implementation and documentation (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/DECISION_EVENT_ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/PAPER_TRADING_AUDIT.md).
